steps.reason: The injected owner head ca6b6684 failed its result check. The thread then ran "Automatic fix: failing checks" (turn 2, round 1 of 3) but reported blocked. Its jevellan_github run-list requests were refused by the thread scope ("A thread can read only its own pull request and runs and job logs on its current head commit"), which the brief deliberately restricts. It read PR #21 (head ca6b6684, the owner commit) while its clean worktree was still at its own earlier head 0a585e3 with the changelog entry, so it could not find the cause. The failure is in how the fix turn discovers the failing run and in its stale worktree, not in the scope rule. There was no new head and no green check within 10 minutes of the injected commit.
